paaQuestions: How can I pay off my loan faster?
How much do I save by paying extra on my loan?
Is it better to pay off a loan early or invest?
Does paying extra reduce principal or interest?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Show the side-by-side payoff date and total interest for minimum vs minimum-plus-extra, with a scenario table for +$50/$100/$200 a month.

paaQuestions: How does the debt snowball method work?
Is the debt snowball or avalanche better?
What debt do you pay off first with the snowball?
How long will the debt snowball take?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Order multiple debts smallest-balance-first and show the rolling payment and debt-free date, with a direct comparison to the avalanche total.

paaQuestions: How does the debt avalanche method work?
How much does the avalanche save versus the snowball?
Which debt do you pay first with the avalanche method?
Is the avalanche method always cheaper?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Order debts by highest interest rate and quantify the interest saved versus the snowball for the same monthly budget.

secondaryKeywords: debt to income calculator for mortgage
paaQuestions: What is a good debt-to-income ratio?
How do I calculate my debt-to-income ratio?
What DTI do lenders want for a mortgage?
Does rent count in debt-to-income ratio?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Show both front-end and back-end DTI against lender thresholds (e.g. 28/36, 43% mortgage cap) and flag which bracket the user falls in.

paaQuestions: Is debt consolidation a good idea?
How much can I save by consolidating debt?
Does debt consolidation hurt your credit?
What credit score do you need to consolidate debt?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Compare the blended cost of several existing debts against a single consolidation loan, including any fee, and show the monthly and total-interest difference.

paaQuestions: How is loan EMI calculated?
What is the formula for EMI?
Does EMI change if interest rate changes?
How can I reduce my EMI?
keywords.uniqueAngle: State the EMI formula plainly, then show the principal-vs-interest split over the term so users see how early EMIs are mostly interest.

paaQuestions: How are personal loan payments calculated?
What is a typical personal loan interest rate?
How much would a $10,000 personal loan cost per month?
Does a personal loan affect credit score?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Include a quick reference table of monthly cost for common amounts and rates so users can sanity-check an offer at a glance.

paaQuestions: What is an amortization schedule?
How is amortization calculated?
Why is most of my early payment interest?
How does an extra payment change amortization?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Render the full month-by-month schedule and highlight the crossover month where payments shift from mostly-interest to mostly-principal.

paaQuestions: How do I compare two loan offers?
Is a lower rate always the cheaper loan?
What is APR and why does it matter when comparing loans?
Should I compare monthly payment or total cost?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Put two offers side by side and rank them on total cost over the full term, not just the headline rate or monthly payment.

paaQuestions: How much interest can I save by prepaying a loan?
Is it better to prepay a loan or reduce the tenure?
Are there penalties for prepaying a loan?
Should I prepay my loan or invest the money?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Model a one-off lump-sum prepayment and let the user choose to reduce either the EMI or the tenure, showing interest saved for each.

paaQuestions: When is it worth refinancing a loan?
How do I calculate refinance savings?
What is the break-even point on a refinance?
Does refinancing hurt your credit?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Compare current loan vs new offer including fees and show the break-even month after which refinancing actually pays off.

How do lenders decide how much to lend me?
How does my other debt affect what I can borrow?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Work backwards from a comfortable monthly payment and DTI limit to the maximum loan amount, not the other way around.

secondaryKeywords: how much loan am i eligible for

What income do I need to qualify for a loan?
How does credit score affect loan eligibility?
Can I increase my loan eligibility?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Estimate the maximum eligible amount from income, existing obligations and a target DTI, and list concrete levers to raise it.

Why do I pay more interest at the start of a loan?

secondaryKeywords: how long to pay off loan
paaQuestions: How do I find the right loan tenure?
Does a longer tenure mean more interest?

Is a shorter loan term always better?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Solve for the tenure that hits a target EMI, and show the interest trade-off of each tenure choice.

paaQuestions: What is the difference between flat and reducing interest rates?

How do I convert a flat rate to a reducing rate?
Which is better, flat or reducing balance?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Expose how a low-sounding flat rate equals a much higher effective reducing rate, with both shown for the same loan.

What happens when the interest-only period ends?
Is an interest-only loan a good idea?
How much lower is an interest-only payment?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Show the low interest-only payment alongside the jump to full repayment once the IO period ends, so the future cost is clear.

paaQuestions: How are line of credit payments calculated?
How is interest charged on a line of credit?
What is the difference between a line of credit and a loan?
How do I pay off a line of credit faster?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Model interest on the drawn balance only, and show how payoff time changes with how much of the limit is used.

paaQuestions: How do I calculate daily interest?
What is a daily periodic rate?
How much interest accrues per day on my balance?
Do loans charge interest every day?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Compute the daily periodic rate from an annual rate and show the interest that accrues each day on the current balance.

paaQuestions: How does a balloon loan work?
How is a balloon payment calculated?
What happens at the end of a balloon loan?
Are balloon loans risky?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Show the lower regular payment and the large final balloon side by side so the lump sum due at the end is never a surprise.

How is gold loan interest charged?

keywords.uniqueAngle: Estimate the loan from gold weight, purity and current rate at the lender LTV cap (lower RPM market, keep effort proportional).

paaQuestions: How does a credit builder loan work?

Do credit builder loans actually raise your score?
How much will I get back at the end?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Show the monthly payment, the total fees/interest cost, and the lump sum released at the end so the true price of building credit is clear.

paaQuestions: How is a late payment penalty calculated?
How much is a late loan payment fee?
Does one late payment hurt your credit?
How long do I have before a payment is late?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Estimate the penalty interest and late fee for days overdue, and note the credit-report impact of a payment 30+ days late.

paaQuestions: How does a bridge loan work?
How much does a bridge loan cost?
How is bridge loan interest calculated?
When should you use a bridge loan?
keywords.uniqueAngle: Total the real short-term cost (interest plus fees) over the bridge period so the convenience can be weighed against the price.
